title: E-Commerce Intelligence Platform
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with AI-powered product recommendations, real-time inventory management and advanced analytics.
problem: A growing retail brand needed to replace their fragmented legacy systems with a unified, intelligent platform that could scale globally.
solution: We built a microservices-based e-commerce platform with ML-powered recommendations, real-time inventory sync and a React-based storefront.
outcome: 40% increase in conversion rate, 60% reduction in inventory discrepancies, platform now serves 50,000+ daily users.

title: AI-Powered HR Management System
description: An intelligent HR platform that automates recruitment, employee management and performance analytics using generative AI.
problem: A mid-sized company struggled with manual HR processes, slow hiring cycles and inability to gain insights from employee data.
solution: We developed an AI-driven HR system with automated resume screening, interview scheduling, performance dashboards and predictive analytics.
outcome: 65% reduction in time-to-hire, automated 80% of initial candidate screening, improved employee retention tracking.

title: Cloud-Native Fintech Platform
description: A secure, scalable financial services platform built cloud-native on AWS with real-time transaction processing and compliance automation.
problem: A fintech startup needed a highly available, compliant payment infrastructure that could handle millions of transactions with zero downtime.
solution: We architected a cloud-native fintech platform using AWS microservices, implementing event-driven architecture with end-to-end encryption.
outcome: 99.99% uptime achieved, processed 2M+ transactions in beta, full regulatory compliance maintained.

title: Healthcare Management Portal
description: A comprehensive patient management and telemedicine platform that connects doctors and patients with intelligent health monitoring.
problem: Healthcare providers needed a unified digital platform for appointment management, patient records and remote consultation capabilities.
solution: Built a HIPAA-compliant healthcare portal with video consultations, AI-assisted diagnostics assistance and electronic health records.
outcome: Reduced appointment no-shows by 45%, enabled 10,000+ remote consultations, streamlined patient data management.
